admission.justification: The unchanged-context family requires every expansion to state why it was admitted and to keep unchanged context bound to the requested measured generation.

conditions: admission is changed or attributed_unchanged, with admission_detail.
attributed_unchanged holds exactly when status is unchanged, and only with path_bound requested_generation.
exclusions: The change inventory's own status vocabulary, which gains no unchanged value.
UI labelling of attributed context (owned by a later leaf).
statement: Every source-content expansion carries admission (changed | attributed_unchanged) and admission_detail, and the model refuses an attributed_unchanged expansion whose status is not unchanged or whose path_bound is not requested_generation.
